reason: Our architect and in-house team already do renders and it's baked into the design fee, so I'm not paying a second vendor for the same thing. And I wouldn't be the one paying anyway, the homeowner would have to agree to it.
objection: We already get 3D from the architect inside their fee, and at $1,500 a home across a library of plans it's a cost I'd have to eat or sell to the homeowner, who may not want to pay for it.
would_change_my_mind: If buyers in our sales center were visibly closing faster or paying for upgrades because of it, and the homeowner agreed to pay for it as a line item so it cost us nothing.
